C_generic.question: Give me all rows of strain.
Give me all the viruses that are also strains.
Seleziona tutti i virus che sono anche degli strain.
dammi gli strain che hanno il campo availbefordis uguale a true
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE availablefordis = true;

C_generic.question: dammi gli strain che hanno il campo vailabefordis uguale a fals
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE availablefordis = false;

C_generic.question: Dammi tutti gli strain che hanno il valore di collectiondate dopo il 2007
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE LENGTH(depositdate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(depositdate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(depositdate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(depositdate, 1, 2) > '2007-12-31' OR (LENGTH(depositdate) = 4 AND depositdate >= '2007');

C_generic.question: Give me all viruses that are also strains that have the field collectiondate after 2007, I want see the field collectiondate and the field otherdenominations
sql_query_variants: SELECT collectiondate, otherdenominations FROM detailedstrain WHERE LENGTH(depositdate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(depositdate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(depositdate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(depositdate, 1, 2) > '2007-12-31' OR (LENGTH(depositdate) = 4 AND depositdate >= '2007');

C_generic.question: Give me all viruses that have the field abbreviation equal to 'LBVV' and the field isolationhost equal to 'Compositae/Lactuca/sp.'
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE abbreviation = 'LBVV' AND isolationhost = 'Compositae/Lactuca/sp.';

C_generic.question: Dammi i virus che hanno il campo abbreviation 'LBVV', il campo isolationhost 'Compositae/Lactuca/sp.' e il campo cultivar 'lattuga Lollo bionda'
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE abbreviation = 'LBVV' AND isolationhost = 'Compositae/Lactuca/sp.' AND cultivar = 'lattuga Lollo bionda';

C_generic.question: Give me the strains that have the field abbreviation equal to 'LBVV' and the field isolationhost equal to 'Compositae/Lactuca/sp.' and the field cultivar equal to 'lattuga Lollo bionda' and storageconditions equal to 'Lyo'.
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE abbreviation = 'LBVV' AND isolationhost = 'Compositae/Lactuca/sp.' AND cultivar = 'lattuga Lollo bionda' AND storageconditions = 'Lyo';

C_generic.question: Quanti strain hanno il campo idetificationtecnique uguale a ELISA?
sql_query_variants: SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM detailedstrain  WHERE identificationtechnique = 'ELISA';
